display.purpose: One short, dominant claim per hero.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The decisive action for inquiry, booking, or opening primary evidence.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 48px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; padding: 14px 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: #171A1B; color: #FFFFFF; font: 600 12px/1.4 ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: .02em; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1), transform 160ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #B93620; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #982D1A; transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #D94A2E; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.description: A restrained supporting action that remains visibly actionable.

narrative.overview: The site is a published operating notebook, not a showroom. It makes the reasoning legible through large direct statements, visible evidence, technical annotations, and a clear path from belief to built system. The surface is cool paper, the typography is ink, and Signal Vermilion marks the small number of details that demand action.
keyCharacteristics: One dominant idea per viewport, written in plain language.
Flat paper-and-ink surfaces with visible rules instead of decorative depth.
Real work, artifacts, and named operating principles as the visual material.
Asymmetric but disciplined layouts that collapse cleanly on small screens.
Motion only for orientation, feedback, and state change; never spectacle.

rules.name: The Ten-Percent Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal Vermilion may occupy no more than ten percent of a viewport. Its rarity is what makes it useful.

rules.name: The No Atmosphere Rule
rules.body: Gradients, colored glows, fog, noise overlays, and tinted glass are prohibited. Color must communicate identity or state.

rules.name: The Say-It-Once Rule
rules.body: A thesis gets one large statement, not a large statement plus an eyebrow that repeats it.

rules.name: The Workbench Rule
rules.body: If a surface cannot explain why it is separate, remove the container and use spacing or a rule.

rules.name: The No Floating Glass Rule
rules.body: Backdrop blur, translucent floating shells, and ambient shadow stacks are prohibited.

dos: Do make the Of One thesis concrete with operating diagrams, named systems, shipped artifacts, and clear outcomes.
Do use Signal Vermilion as a rare action or evidence marker and keep it below ten percent of the viewport.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus, semantic headings, 44px touch targets, and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't use generic black-and-gold AI luxury.
Don't use glassy futurist dashboards, backdrop blur, translucent navigation shells, or ambient glow.
Don't use crypto and neon grids or mystical tech symbolism.
Don't fall back to safe corporate-consultant templates or resume-style founder sites.
Don't arrange every idea as a generic SaaS card grid.
Don't use editorial-magazine affectation as a default or repeat tiny uppercase eyebrow labels above every heading.
Don't make vague claims without visible proof.
